meta.name: A Couple of Lies
meta.description: A seemingly idyllic home swap between Sicily and Stockholm turns toxic as two wealthy couples go to extremes to protect themselves — and their secrets.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Two couples arrive in Sicily and the Stockholm archipelago for a holiday home swap, but unsettling details about their new houses make it hard to relax.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A shocking discovery puts Carl and Helene on edge. Scarlett grows suspicious of Adam after an awkward surprise sours their romantic Stockholm lunch.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As a long-held secret unravels, Helene's sudden choice puts Carl in a perilous position. Scarlett receives devastating news that shatters her world.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the wake of a spiraling chain of events in Sicily, a twisting web of lies and scheming threatens to reveal a disturbing — and deadly — truth.
